entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A battle-worn kor line-slinger, veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate and member of the Expeditionary House, who plans a mission to Murasa.

entities.name: Zareth
entities.description: A lanky merfolk and Akiri's old friend, a former thief and Battle conscript who has recently returned to Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A friend who wept when Zareth left Sea Gate.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: A dramatic friend who cursed Zareth's flight and threatened to kill him if he returned.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan that attacked Sea Gate, freed from its ancient chains.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic, world-devouring beings defeated in the Battle for Zendikar.

entities.name: Expeditionary House
entities.description: The Sea Gate organization of rangers, line-slingers and adventurers.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The wounded plane of floating hedrons and the Roil.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The coastal city at the mouth of Halimar Bay that Akiri and Zareth call home.

entities.name: Umara River Gorge
entities.description: A deep gorge on Tazeem used by line-slingers on the hookroutes, including Red Route.

entities.name: Red Route
entities.description: A difficult, quick hookroute up the Umara River Gorge that Akiri set during the Battle.

entities.name: Magosi Portage
entities.description: A long hall and outbuildings atop Magosi Falls serving as a rest stop for travelers.

entities.name: Magosi Falls
entities.description: The tallest waterfall on the gorge, a three-hundred-foot step.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The Zendikari region that holds the Umara River Gorge.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: The Skyclave destination where Akiri hopes to find something powerful.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The region of floating hedron shards in the sky.

entities.name: Coralhelm
entities.description: The destination of the caravan Akiri has booked.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: The place where Zareth got his Skyclave hooks.

entities.name: Halimar Bay
entities.description: The bay at whose mouth Sea Gate stands.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war against the Eldrazi that Akiri and Zareth fought in.

entities.name: Fallen hedron
entities.description: An ancient artifact rumored to have fallen, which turns out to be missing.

entities.name: Skyclave hook
entities.description: Etched hooks from the Skyclave ruins that Zareth gives to Akiri.

events.summary: Akiri and Zareth swing up the Umara River Gorge along the Red Route, seeking a fallen hedron on behalf of Sea Gate.
events.quote: they had been dispatched by Sea Gate to follow up on rumors of a fallen hedron

events.summary: Camped on the gorge rim, Akiri reflects on the Eldrazi, Ulamog and the reminders Zareth's return brings.
events.quote: Akiri recalled the chill in Sea Gate under Ulamog

events.summary: Zareth gives Akiri a Skyclave hook from the kor of the Trenches in Ondu.
events.quote: you take it, I have others.

events.summary: Akiri remembers the Battle at Sea Gate and how inexperienced Zareth was when pressed into her unit.
events.quote: He had been pressed into the liberation of Sea Gate because he could hold a spear

events.summary: Zareth apologizes for leaving Sea Gate and Akiri forgives him, welcoming him home.
events.quote: I'm happy to have you back.

events.summary: They reach the site of the fallen hedron and find only a strange pool, no artifact.
events.quote: It's not a rock, it's an artifact

events.summary: Akiri decides to return to Sea Gate to continue their work.
events.quote: We go back to Sea Gate,

events.summary: At Magosi Portage, Akiri reveals she has hired them onto a caravan to Coralhelm, after Zareth's coin purse prank backfires.
events.quote: A caravan bound for Coralhelm, set to depart tomorrow.

events.summary: Zareth guesses Akiri plans to volunteer them for a secret Skyclave expedition to Murasa and Akiri confirms.
events.quote: Sea Gate thought we might find something useful from a freshly fallen hedron

events.summary: Zareth proposes they slip away, but Akiri refuses, insisting on fixing Zendikar and creating power for its people.
events.quote: This is our world, all of its agonies and sickness.

events.summary: Zareth promises to be there, and Akiri leaves; he spends the night awake.
events.quote: The night dragged on long, and Zareth spent none of it asleep.

relations.note: Old friends and companions on the mission.
relations.quote: Zareth, her old friend and companion

relations.note: She led him in the Battle and critiques his slinging.
relations.quote: the young kor officer who pulled him through the darkness at Sea Gate

relations.note: She is a line-slinger and expedition leader of the House.
relations.quote: the rangers, line-slingers, and adventurers of the Expeditionary House

relations.note: She fought them during the Battle.
relations.quote: The Eldrazi killed with a touch—some with their mere presence.

relations.note: Ulamog loomed over Sea Gate during the Battle.
relations.quote: in the shadow of the beast free of its ancient chains
